# XingAI Travel AI — UX V1

> Decide where to go from your real constraints — describe the trip, compare destinations with trade-offs, and get one bookable itinerary.

## Product

- **Repo:** xingai-travel-ai
- **UX path:** docs/ux-v1/
- **Live (future):** travel.xingai.app

## Flow

1. **Your trip** — dates, budget, departure, travelers, vibe (paste or type).
2. **Recommend a destination** — trip style (city / beach / nature / culture) + pace (relaxed / balanced / adventure).
3. **Plan it** — winner destination, itinerary snapshot, book-first list, simple/detailed day plan, trade-off note.

## Gallery pages

- index.html — screen picker
- mobile-input.html, mobile-result.html
- desktop-input.html, desktop-result.html
